The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) on Friday reminded the public to stop dumping garbage into canals and waterways, citing waste accumulation as a leading cause of flooding in Metro Manila.

The reminder came after floodwaters along EDSA northbound from Dario Bridge to Landers and the LRT-1 Balintawak Station in Barangay Apolonio Samson, Quezon City only subsided early Wednesday after crews cleared trash blocking drainage inlets following heavy rains.
